The camera stays locked in this position for the duration — a long, unhurried hold shot. Lighting is entirely practical and ambient: the single warm amber lantern on the building facade upper-right, the subtle red glow of the SUV tail lights at mid-left, and the dim wet-street reflections below. The overall palette is deep, dark moody tones — near-black throughout — punctuated only by those two warm amber and red light sources. No fill lights, no flash.
